_comment: Ground truth from the Scala reference stack (sigma-state 6.0.2 + ergo-core 6.0.2,
the versions mainnet runs). Pins what ContextExtension.serializer.parse accepts as an
ValueSerializer, admitting every subclass of the sealed EvaluatedValue trait
(Constant, ConcreteCollection, GroupGenerator, Tuple), not only Constant.
Also pins the runtime shape a Tuple-node context var takes: Tuple.value is a Coll,
so a tuple-typed consumer fails with InterpreterException while isDefined succeeds.
Generated with scripts/jvm_serde_oracle-style scala-cli harness; verdicts and costs
are the JVM's, never a Rust self-oracle.
